description: Wages $3,000/mo; municipal bond interest of $8,400 in each of the last two years ($700/mo), reported as tax-exempt interest on two years of signed returns. No bond holdings are used for the down payment or closing costs, and nothing shows that the holdings will be depleted. The account statements show that every bond matures more than three years after the application date. The borrower lives in a state with no income tax. A single wage earner with the borrower's total income (taxable and nontaxable together, add-on included) is in the 12% federal bracket or lower, so the federal and state taxes that such a wage earner pays on an amount equal to the nontaxable income (at most 12% income tax plus 7.65% payroll tax) are 25% or less of that amount.
